Thanks Tara — great notes. We're aligned on scope; proposing the sequence below (first pass). Putting Marissa and Laura on copy to flesh out task owners.

Proposed embedded MAP sequence (summary):
1) Pre-cutover (week -2 to 0)
   - Access and network checks (Laura)
   - Feature flag plan and compatibility matrix (Sofia/Engineering)
   - Training prep + materials (Marissa)

2) Canary (EU-first) — 7 days
   - Canary targets: 10% production traffic, dedicated KV cache per tenant
   - Feature flags to toggle: incremental output caching, model variant A (quantized), fallback to hosted LLM 2 if errors > 2%
   - Acceptance gates: latency < 220ms P95, error rate < 0.5%

3) Read-only verification window — 24 hours after canary pass
   - Verify logs, audit trail, and sample prompt regressions (SLA team + Nebula)

4) Global cutover & staged ramp (week +1)
   - Canary->50%->100% over 72 hours with monitoring runbook

5) Training & handoff
   - Two live 90-min cohorts (one scheduled during canary week, one post-cutover)
   - Recording + condensed runbook shared post-training

We'll include a rollback plan: immediate feature-flag revert + DNS traffic steering back to previous endpoint within 30 minutes.

Attachments: initial outline (RI_MAP_implementation_outline.pdf).

Can you confirm Nebula's preferred start date for canary (your attached spreadsheet suggests 8/6)? If yes, we'll convert this into a mutual action plan doc and share a DocuSign-ready statement of work by Friday.

Best,
